title: Tracecat 1.0.0-beta.52-rc.10
body_markdown:
## Performance improvements


- fix(engine): Enforce registry cache capacity invariants ([#3262](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3262) )
- fix(engine): Retry transient registry cache contention ([#3264](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3264) )


## Bug fixes


- fix(api): Return adjacent reverse pages ([#3258](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3258) )
- fix: Retry actions after heartbeat timeouts ([#3266](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3266) )


## Other


- feat(api): Add universal cursor pagination ([#3256](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3256) )
